title: Resource Explorer wire contract
description: Version 1 of every payload GET /api/tree, GET /api/content and GET /api/search return. Where this schema and CONTRACT.md disagree, this file wins. A discovery failure is data: only a malformed node id, an unusable search term and a missing principal are non-200.

schemaVersion.description: Breaking any field below requires 2 or a parallel endpoint.

nodeStatus.description: The operator's diagnosis. 'forbidden' is fixed by a role grant; 'unreachable' is a network or private-DNS path and a role grant does nothing for it; 'unavailable' is the service saying no or an SDK missing; 'unconfigured' is a coordinate nobody set; 'empty' is a true answer. Truncation is the separate 'truncated' boolean, because a truncated listing did succeed.

nodeKind.description: root: the subscription. resource_group: one group. resource_type: a grouping of one ARM type inside a group, labelled 'Type (n)'. resource: one Azure resource. collection: a named branch under a resource, either an ARM child collection or a data plane. arm_child: one item of an ARM child collection, expandable into its own properties and sub-collections. properties: the universal leaf holding a resource's complete ARM JSON. The remaining kinds are one per data plane.

contentKind.description: How to render the payload. text, json, csv and markdown populate 'text'. image populates 'dataBase64' and 'mediaType'. binary populates both 'text', a hex-and-ASCII preview, and 'dataBase64'. rows populates 'rows' and 'columns'. none populates nothing.

detail.description: At most 40 keys; each value at most 500 characters, truncated with an ellipsis. Every string has passed azdata's sanitize_detail, so no URL, key or connection string appears here.

nodeId.description: Opaque. 'root' is the one literal id; everything else is base64url of canonical JSON minted by this server. A client constructs none, parses none, and derives nothing from one.

hasContent.description: True when GET /api/content?node=<id> returns a payload. Independent of 'expandable': a Kusto table has contents and no children, a Search index has both.

status.description: What is already known about this child. A child is never speculatively probed, so a discovered child is 'ok' even where expanding it would fail.

error.description: Null if and only if status is 'ok' or 'empty'.

fixtures.description: True when RESOURCE_EXPLORER_FAKE_DISCOVERY produced this. Mandatory: numbers from nowhere presented as real is the failure a fixture mode exists to avoid.

breadcrumb.description: Labels from the root to this node, inclusive. Derived from the node id alone, so a deep link costs no extra call.

status.description: The outcome of THIS expansion, not of its children.

truncated.description: True when the plane truncated or the 500-child server clamp applied. There is no paging cursor.

mediaType.description: The type the payload should be interpreted as. For an image it is safe to place in a data: URL. SVG is never returned as an image, because it is a script-bearing document.

text.description: Populated for text, json, csv and markdown, and as a hex-and-ASCII preview for binary. Capped at 200000 characters, truncated with an ellipsis.

dataBase64.description: Standard base64 of the bytes returned, for image and binary.

rows.description: At most 100 documents or rows. Cell values are scalars or bounded strings; a nested structure arrives as its bounded string form.

columns.description: Column order: the service's declared order where it has one, else first appearance. Never sorted.

sizeBytes.description: The size of the UNDERLYING object, not of what was returned. They differ exactly when 'truncated' is true. For rows it is the number of rows returned.

node.description: Expandable directly: a hit is addressable without walking the tree down to it.

matchedIn.description: Which field matched: name, type, resourceGroup, location, tags or properties.

query.description: The trimmed term that was executed. The one place client input is echoed, and only after passing the length bound and being interpolated as a KQL literal.

invalidNodeError.description: HTTP 400. Echoes nothing that was submitted: the client already has the token, and reflecting it would make the endpoints accepting client input a reflection surface.

invalidQueryError.description: HTTP 400. An empty search term, or one over 200 characters.
